groups.description: Fast-start collections for active recall practice.

groups.name: CEFR
groups.description: Official collections organized by CEFR level.

collections.name: Fluency Fast Track 1
collections.description: Essential German sentence patterns for the first practice loop.

collections.name: Fluency Fast Track 2
collections.description: Everyday German sentences with slightly longer context.

collections.name: A1
collections.description: Beginner CEFR practice for simple German statements and questions.

collections.name: A2
collections.description: Elementary CEFR practice with reasons, plans, and everyday details.

fluency-fast-track-1.translation: We live in a small apartment.
The children are playing in the park.
She is reading a short book.
The dog sleeps under the table.

fluency-fast-track-2.translation: I want to get up early tomorrow.
We have to buy the tickets online.

fluency-fast-track-2.text: Ich habe meine Tasche im Zug {{vergessen}}.
fluency-fast-track-2.translation: I forgot my bag on the train.
The waiter will bring the bill soon.
We are waiting in front of the entrance.

fluency-fast-track-2.text: Ich rufe dich später noch einmal {{an}}.
fluency-fast-track-2.translation: I will call you again later.
The museum is closed on Mondays.
She is wearing a blue coat today.

fluency-fast-track-2.text: Wir haben genug Zeit für einen {{Spaziergang}}.
fluency-fast-track-2.translation: We have enough time for a walk.
I still have to answer my emails.
The supermarket opens at eight o’clock.

fluency-fast-track-2.text: Ich suche einen ruhigen Platz zum {{Lernen}}.
fluency-fast-track-2.translation: I am looking for a quiet place to study.
The lamp is next to the sofa.
He explains the task very patiently.

fluency-fast-track-2.text: Wir treffen uns vor dem Kino um {{sechs}}.
fluency-fast-track-2.translation: We are meeting in front of the cinema at six.
I am looking forward to the weekend.

a1.translation: I buy a loaf of bread.
I am taking the bus today.

a2.text: Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil ich {{krank}} bin.
a2.translation: I am staying home because I am sick.

a2.text: Nachdem ich gefrühstückt habe, {{gehe}} ich zur Arbeit.
a2.translation: After I have breakfast, I go to work.

a2.text: Kannst du das Fenster bitte {{öffnen}}?
a2.translation: Can you please open the window?

a2.text: Ich habe gestern einen Film {{gesehen}}.
Wir möchten im Sommer nach Wien {{reisen}}.
a2.translation: We would like to travel to Vienna in summer.

a2.text: Der Termin wurde auf Freitag {{verschoben}}.
a2.translation: The appointment was moved to Friday.

a2.text: Ich interessiere mich für moderne {{Kunst}}.
a2.translation: I am interested in modern art.

a2.text: Er hat mir eine lange Nachricht {{geschickt}}.
a2.translation: He sent me a long message.

a2.text: Obwohl es regnet, gehen wir {{spazieren}}.
a2.translation: Although it is raining, we are going for a walk.

a2.text: Ich muss meine Wohnung bis morgen {{aufräumen}}.
a2.translation: I have to tidy my apartment by tomorrow.

a2.text: Die Reise dauert ungefähr drei {{Stunden}}.
a2.translation: The trip takes about three hours.

a2.text: Ich habe vergessen, den Herd {{auszumachen}}.
a2.translation: I forgot to turn off the stove.

a2.text: Sie bewirbt sich um eine neue {{Stelle}}.
a2.translation: She is applying for a new position.

a2.text: Wir vergleichen die Preise vor dem {{Kauf}}.
a2.translation: We compare the prices before buying.

a2.text: Ich habe den Schlüssel im Auto {{gelassen}}.
a2.translation: I left the key in the car.

a2.text: Der Arzt empfiehlt mehr {{Bewegung}}.
Wir sollten früher mit der Planung {{beginnen}}.
Ich habe mich über die Einladung sehr {{gefreut}}.
a2.translation: I was very happy about the invitation.

a2.text: Die Verkäuferin hat mir die Größe {{empfohlen}}.
a2.translation: The saleswoman recommended the size to me.

a2.text: Wir treffen uns, sobald du {{ankommst}}.
a2.translation: We will meet as soon as you arrive.
